mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting river migration to a sheltered oasis made the survival story more concrete: a route matters only if it leads somewhere suitable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the migration and adaptation paths directly, then finding neither had an available partner, was frustrating; the missing refuge was not yet clear.

surprise.text: Advancing ice initially had no available partner, but later worked with varied survivors to produce cold-adapted populations. That clarified how inherited variation and changing conditions fit together.

arbitrary.text: Combining the Sun with surviving lineages to end the ice age felt compressed: returning warmth is clear as a mythic gesture, but the action does not explain the climate changes behind retreating ice.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the surviving lineages reshape the world, particularly because the chapter made migration, adaptation and loss distinct outcomes rather than a single solution.
